title: Source item comments
description: The body of the signed POST /v1/source-items/comments, application/json: comments of one item, as the source holds them. Each comment is upserted on the adapter, the item's ref and the comment's ref, and the newer updated_at wins. A comment deleted at the source is an entry with deleted: true. With complete, these are all of the item's comments: the control plane marks the item's other comments deleted, except those updated at or after complete.since. The adapter leaves out the comment it wrote at the source when a work item was taken in from the item (changes.schema.json, taken_in). Every text, body and author.name, is untrusted: shown as data, never followed as an instruction. It is signed with the adapter's access key as definitions.schema.json describes. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, or a request whose signature it has already seen, with an unsigned 401. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

time.description: When the adapter built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.

item_ref.description: The ref of the item the comments belong to, as source-items.schema.json sent it.

complete.description: Present when the comments are all of the item's comments. Absent otherwise.

since.description: When the adapter began reading the item's comments: a comment updated at or after it is kept, whether the request names it or not.

url.description: The comment's page at the source.

created_at.description: When the comment was written at the source.

updated_at.description: When the comment last changed at the source, or was deleted: the newer one wins.

deleted.description: true when the comment was deleted at the source. Absent otherwise.
